game.name: Blades Of Time (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It,Ru)
game.desc: Blades of Time is an action game for Xbox 360. You play as Ayumi, a treasure hunter who finds herself trapped on the island she came to search. Fortunately, Ayumi has the gift of being able to go back in time, creating a clone that repeats her past actions. This power will prove indispensable in overcoming the hordes of enemies that assail you and in solving certain puzzles.
